name: codebase-cleanup-review
description: Evidence-based cleanup review of a codebase: dead code, duplicates, unused UI components, overengineering, legacy code, redundant queries and API calls, and abandoned files. Reports first, applies changes only on approval.

interface.shortDescription: Find code you can safely remove or simplify
interface.longDescription: Reviews a codebase for dead code, duplicate logic, unused UI components, overengineering, legacy code, redundant queries and abandoned files. It writes a report with evidence, risks and a phased cleanup plan, and only changes code you approve.
defaultPrompt: Run a cleanup review of this repository
Find dead code in src/ and tell me what is safe to delete
